tables.name: Opportunities
tables.description: Extra Intrigue. Problems the villagers are dealing with, that they may need help with.

results.name: Thief
results.description: Someone has been absconding with large amounts of the village’s major crop, or resource.

results.name: Wildlife
results.description: Local wildlife has been harassing the villagers, or animals.

results.name: Monster(s)
results.description: Something worse than simple wildlife is terrorizing the village.

results.name: Haunting
results.description: A spirit haunts some place within the village. Something was done to this person while they were alive that has tied the spirit to this place.

results.name: Party Time
results.description: A festival is coming up soon, and a shipment carrying something important for the event has not arrived.

results.name: Shady Doings
results.description: Strange symbols are discovered written on the walls of certain homes, or other buildings. Bits of bones, or piles of stones, placed just-so have been found. Something, or someone, is trying to send a message, or accomplish a less-than-savory task. What is it and why is it happening?
